notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
⭐ What's New?


You can now store an unlimited number of ostriches in the new Bird Box. It comes with filters so you can quickly find what you’re looking for.

Ostriches can now be picked up and dropped while the game is paused. This also means you can put them into the Bird Box or the delivery area without unpausing.

Added a Reroll Orders feature. Rerolls allow you to get a new set of orders by paying a small amount of essence. Keep an eye out for reward cards that let you reroll for free!


🛠️ Bug Fixes & Optimization


Performance improvements across the board

Fixed an issue where the time bar wasn’t working properly

Fixed a bug that stopped the egg tray from holding more than 3 eggs

Eggs now spawn correctly in egg trays and nests after loading a save

Fixed a bug where baby ostriches could get stuck after playing

Fixed an issue where food troughs and water bowls could stop working

Fixed a bug where build objects could be misaligned on the grid after dropping them

Babies will now stop following an adult ostrich if it is picked up



We hope the new Bird Box helps you manage larger flocks more easily, and this update should also smooth out some of those egg and baby issues. Thanks for playing and giving feedback.

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
🛠️ Bug Fixes & Optimization


Performance improvements

Fixed a crash that could occur at the start of the game

Fixed an issue where baby ostriches could get stuck in certain situations

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
⭐ What's New?
Two new bicolor patterns have been added. We hope you enjoy discovering them!


🛠️ Bug Fixes & Optimization
Improved rendering performance

Fixed a small texture issue

Fixed a bug where baby ostriches didn’t behave as expected

Fixed an issue where build items sometimes failed to load properly after loading a savegame



If you’ve got a lot of ostriches, you should notice things running a bit smoother after this update. More optimization will follow.

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
🛠️ Bug Fixes & Optimization
The reward for egg colors is now applied correctly when loading a savegame

Minor UI improvements



Thanks again for playing and sharing your feedback 🐣

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
🧯 Hotfix

Fixed a bug that prevented eggs from being placed in the egg processor

Fixed an issue where leftover starting enclosures weren't removed after choosing one

Thank you for reporting bugs and giving feedback. We're currently working on performance improvements for large farms in the next update.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.2
notes.content:
⭐ What's New?

 The inspect panel now shows an ostrich’s parents
 You can manually grow up baby ostriches from the inspect panel
 Female ostriches will now display a thought bubble when they have an egg ready


🛠️ Bug Fixes & Optimization

 General performance improvements
 Updated pickup visual effects
 Adjusted genetics rules to improve consistency in breeding outcomes
 Updated UI elements
 Added a new setting to toggle the tutorial on or off
 Various bug fixes and small improvements


Thanks again for playing and sharing your feedback 🐣

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.1
notes.content:
⭐ What's New?

 Two game modes: Standard mode allows you to keep playing when you fail an order while in challenge mode, a failed order is the end of the run.
 Bring two male ostriches together to have them perform a dance battle! The winner will mutate and change colors.
 Inspect tool: Click on the magnifying glass and select an ostrich to see its feather, beak and skin colors as well as food and water effects
 When picking up an ostrich, available actions are shown visually


🛠️ Bug Fixes & Optimization

 Color inheritance was overhauled to make breeding outcomes more predictable.
 Improved pathfinding for ostriches
 Fixed an order fulfillment bug
 Added tutorial hints
 When growing up, baby ostriches will keep their names


As always, thanks for all your feedback and support. 🐣

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2.5
notes.content:
⭐ What's New?

 Added a pause and fast forward feature
 Items can be re-positioned in new pause mode
 New volume sliders


We hope having a fast forward button will improve your experience. Next, we will work on improving the graphics settings. 🐥🥚

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2.4
notes.content:
⭐ What's New?

 Edge scrolling added! Move your camera by moving the cursor to the edges of the screen
 A new hint has been added to guide you on releasing ostriches
 Ostriches with multiple colors will now count towards "any color" order requirements


🛠️ Bug Fixes & Optimization

 Audio tweaks: Volume control now properly adjusts various sound effects and music
 Fixed a performance drop that occurred when ostriches were looking for an empty shelter
 Fixed an issue where scrolling inside certain UI elements triggered zoom
 Corrected a German translation error


Thank you to everyone who provided feedback - we're looking forward to further improving the game. If you come across any issues or have ideas for improvements, we'd love to hear from you. 😄
